CustomField.formula: If(ISPICKVAL( Customer_Support_Satisfaction__c , "Extremely Satisfied"),2, If(ISPICKVAL( Customer_Support_Satisfaction__c , "Somewhat Satisfied"),1, If(ISPICKVAL( Customer_Support_Satisfaction__c , "Neutral"),0, If(ISPICKVAL( Customer_Support_Satisfaction__c , "Somewhat Dissatisfied"),-1, If(ISPICKVAL( Customer_Support_Satisfaction__c , "Extremely Dissatisfied"),-2,NULL)))))
CustomField.label: Customer Support Satisfaction Rating
